captions.caption: A man enters a forest clearing carrying a long wooden log on his shoulder.
He walks towards the center of the cleared patch of ground.
The man sets the large log down on the forest floor.
He walks towards a green backpack and some other gear on the ground.
He picks up a thinner wooden pole from near the backpack.
The man carries the thin pole towards the center of the clearing.
He begins to shave the bark off the end of the pole with a hand tool.
Wood shavings fall to the ground as he continues to peel the bark.
He works quickly, stripping several inches of bark from the pole.
The man continues to clean the end of the wooden pole.
He makes several more strokes with the tool to remove remaining bark.
He focuses on the end of the pole, preparing it for planting.
More bark is removed as he rotates the pole in his hand.
He finishes the bark removal and inspects the cleaned end.
The man stands up and carries the prepared pole across the clearing.
He walks towards a pre-dug hole in the dirt.
He positions himself over the hole, holding the pole vertically.
He prepares to insert the cleaned end of the pole into the hole.
The man lowers the pole base into the narrow hole in the ground.
He adjusts the pole to ensure it sits deep and straight.
He holds the pole steady as he prepares to secure it.
The camera angle shifts to a close-up of the pole base in the hole.
The man lifts and rams the pole into the hole several times to settle it.
He holds the pole firmly as it rests in the dirt.
He continues to push and pull the pole to make it firm.
He lifts the pole slightly and slams it back down into the hole.
He repeats the ramming motion to compact the soil at the bottom.
He uses his boot to push loose soil into the gap around the pole.
The man tamps down the soil with the side of his foot.
He finishes tamping and stands still for a moment.
The man kneels down on the ground next to the pole.
He reaches for a pile of small stones nearby.
He starts dropping stones into the gap between the pole and the hole walls.
He adds several more stones to reinforce the base.
He uses his hand to push the stones deeper into the hole.
He reaches out to grab more small rocks from the forest floor.
He drops another handful of stones into the hole around the pole.
He carefully arranges the stones to wedge the pole in place.
He pushes down on the stones with his fingers.
More small stones are added to the hole.
He continues to pack the stones tightly around the wood.
He reaches for another stone to fill a gap.
He checks the stability of the pole by gently rocking it.
He puts another stone into the hole to improve the fit.
He continues the process of packing stones around the base.
He adjusts the angle of the pole while holding it with one hand.
He checks the pole's vertical alignment from a kneeling position.
He grabs a few more small stones to finish the stone packing.
He drops the final set of stones into the hole.
He packs the stones down firmly with his hand.
He begins to scrape loose dirt over the stones into the hole.
He uses his hands to push more soil around the pole base.
He continues filling the hole with dirt until it is level with the ground.
He uses his hands to pack the soil down over the stones.
He smooths the surface of the dirt around the planted pole.
He continues to pat the dirt down to make it firm.
He uses the palm of his hand to level the soil.
He scrapes a bit more loose dirt from the surrounding area.
He pushes the last bit of dirt into the hole.
He finishes leveling and packing the dirt around the base of the pole.
